alibabacloud-livedebug 0.0.1-beta.1

- Initial beta release of live-debug runtime diagnostics for Alibaba Cloud CMS ServiceTask.
- Supports dynamic logging, method snapshots, dynamic metrics, spans, and JVM inspection for Java (LOG/SNAPSHOT probes + JVM commands) and Python (LOG/SNAPSHOT/METRIC/SPAN/SPAN_TAG probes only).
- Prerequisite and compatibility checks for CLI, plugins, and SLS are included.
- Enforces global conventions: strict workspace/service resolution, session-based user-agent for traceability, and two-phase execution for destructive operations.
- Read-only operations execute directly; all errors are parsed and handled with explicit user prompts for recovery.
- Excludes APM agent onboarding, CMS alerts, RUM, Prometheus rules, and billing actions.
